title: Shared definitions for the three project files
description: Units are fixed: mm, degrees C, W, W/(m K), C/W. A blank value is left out of the file; null is never used.

schema.description: Which file this is: pcb-thermal/project, pcb-thermal/cad or pcb-thermal/results.

savedBy.description: Program and version that wrote the file, e.g. 'page 0.1.0' or 'ImportStep (VBA)'.

dateTime.description: Local time, ISO 8601 without zone, e.g. 2026-10-18T11:20:00.

refDes.description: Reference designator from the schematic, e.g. U1. Links a part to its body.

bodyKey.description: Stable id of a body. Import STEP makes it from the body name; it stays the same on re-import. Bodies typed in by the user start with m_.

cPerW.description: Thermal resistance in C/W (same as K/W).

box.description: Axis aligned box in board coordinates: X along the board length, Y along its width, Z up from the PCB bottom face.

partialBox.description: Some or all of a box. Used for overrides: each value given replaces the imported one.

side.description: Which face of the PCB the body sits on.

heightMode.description: How the gap between chip and plate is filled: a pedestal on the plate plus a thin TIM, or a TIM that fills the whole gap.

timMode.description: Body = the TIM is a solid part in the model. Contact R = the TIM is a thermal contact resistance only.

plateHeightMode.description: Auto = plate face set by the tallest covered chip plus its TIM. Manual = the height typed in.

chipModel.description: How a chip is modelled in the study: one block with a calibrated k, or a two-resistor (Rjc, Rjb) model.

studyType.description: Thermal = SolidWorks Simulation steady state. Flow = SolidWorks Flow Simulation.
